verdict.rationale: Vue's own Form Input Bindings guide documents the built-in v-model directive, which syncs input, textarea and select elements with reactive state. That covers the form-building and framework-integration part of the story, but the evidence pack shows no first-party form module and no validation capability. missing for 10: first-party form validation, a dedicated official forms module or library, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework

citations.quote: When dealing with forms on the frontend, we often need to sync the state of form input elements with corresponding state in JavaScript.
In addition, v-model can be used on inputs of different types, <textarea>, and <select> elements.
